_note: Experimental macro pKa for nucleotides, from literature. Used for pKa READ-OFF comparison only: the ABSOLUTE net charge of a polyphosphate depends on the low-pH primary-phosphate convention (Sigel notes several acid-strength models give different H+ counts), so we compare the engine curve's INFLECTIONS to these pKa, not the absolute Z. Values are multi-source consensus at ~25 C, I~0.1; Reference check 2026-10-05: the one DOI (10.1021/bi00903a019) resolves, and Crossref, PubMed (PMID 14069537) and the ACS page agree on title, journal, volume, issue, pages and year; the author list differs between sources (4 names at ACS/Crossref, 3 at PubMed), so it is cited as Phillips et al. The Dawson book exists (3rd ed., Clarendon Press). The Alberty value and the Sigel remark carry no specific citation and are unverified. No pKa value was re-checked against the full texts.
